notes:
Summary: Early-stage product (IDE copilot for enterprise codebases). Primary differentiator: deep repository indexing + near-real-time embedding refresh to keep suggestions current across mono-repos.

Key technical requirements (from Prod/Infra call):
- UX: completions & streaming must hit ~50-80ms p99 in-editor for short completions (<=150 tokens).
- Model handling: need explicit model/version pinning per workspace and staged rollouts (canary + rollback).
- Background workloads: nightly full embedding refresh for ~3M files (approx 200GB of source), plus continuous incremental pipeline that ingests commits; expect sustained embedding throughput of ~4k-6k files/sec during bulk backfill windows.
- Indexing: hybrid index (semantic + symbol-aware), incremental batching, snapshotting for rollbacks.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering-led; want per-token transparency and batching suggestions to reduce unit cost.
- Security: SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency for a subset of enterprise customers.

What they told us: "We can tolerate a slower bulk embedding job if the streaming path for the IDE stays sub-100ms p99 — dev experience matters more than raw cost."

Internal notes: POC should validate: streaming latency on VS Code + JetBrains plugin, KV cache hit rates for repeated completions, and incremental embedding delta pipeline (can we do warm-starts to reduce recompute?). Price elasticity: they will evaluate Dedicated if unit cost for embeddings + streaming meets threshold.

Ask list for SE: give config for batching window sizes, recommended quantization profiles for code models, fallback routing plan (fast small model for p99 spikes), and a plan for stateful rolling upgrades of model versions.
